overview_description.description:
Oman Arab Bank SAOC establish in 1984 following the acquisition of Arab Bank’s branches in the Sultanate. Over the past three decades, the Bank has consistently expanded its reach as well as its products and services offering to provide customers in the country with a comprehensive suite of innovative solutions in Retail banking, Corporate and Project finance, Investment banking, trade finance and most recently, Islamic Banking.

Oman Arab Bank operates more than 65 branches and offices, and more than 135 ATMs in high footfall locations across the Sultanate that are supported by Arab Bank’s 600 branches spanning five continents. The Bank’s principal shareholders are Oman International Development and Investment Company SAOG (50.99%) and Arab Bank PLC (49%) and As of December 31st 2015, the Bank’s total assets stood at RO 1.98 Billion (USD 5.15 Billion) and net worth of RO 226 Million (USD 587 Million).

about_short_description.short_description: Oman Arab Bank is a commercial bank based in Ruwi, Oman that provides personal, retail and commercial banking services.

product.name: Personal Accounts and Deposits
product.description: Deposit accounts for individuals, including current, savings, youth, minor, child, growth, fixed-deposit, high-yield and structured savings options.

product.name: Personal Loans and Financing
product.description: Consumer financing for personal needs, home purchases and vehicles through personal loans, Al Dar Home Loan and Car Loan products.

product.name: Cards
product.description: Payment cards for individuals and businesses, including credit, debit, prepaid and corporate cards, with card management and merchant acceptance services.

product.name: Digital Banking and Payment Services
product.description: Digital banking through mobile and internet channels, ATMs, remote service points, direct debit, IBAN tools and international remittances through iSend.

product.name: Bancassurance and Personal Insurance
product.description: Insurance products distributed through the bank, covering motor, health, travel, home contents and comprehensive personal risks.

product.name: Corporate Banking
product.description: Business banking services covering corporate accounts, financing, payments, liquidity and financial management for companies and institutions.
